decision_conditions: <div><span style="font-size: 11pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">The proposed two-storey rear extension, when in combination with the proposed two-storey rear extension,&nbsp;would be overwhelming and appear disproportionately large in comparison to the modest size of the original dwellinghouse and&nbsp;</span></span><span style="font-size: 11pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">fail to respect character and appearance of the dwellinghouse and surrounding area.
